Atalanta vs Borussia Dortmund: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the UEFA Champions League continues to heat up, Atalanta prepares to face off against Borussia Dortmund in what promises to be an exhilarating matchup. Both teams have been in fine form domestically, and this clash is critical, as it could determine their fates in the knockout stages of Europe's premier club competition. With both teams boasting a wealth of attacking talent, fans can expect an exciting game filled with chances and strategic battles. Kick-off: 25.02.2026, 17:45 UTC / 20:45 MSK
Stadium: Gewiss Stadium

Match Preview

Atalanta enters this fixture with an impressive run of form in Serie A, showcasing a high-octane attacking style that has yielded plenty of goals. Under the astute management of Gian Piero Gasperini, the team has thrived on the fast-paced transition play. However, defensive inconsistencies have sometimes marred their performances, and they’ll need to shore up their backline against the dynamic attacking players of Dortmund. Borussia Dortmund, on the other hand, has had its fair share of ups and downs in the Bundesliga. Despite struggling with injuries at times this season, Marco Rose has orchestrated a strong attacking framework, relying on the pace and precision of players like Erling Haaland and Marco Reus. Their ability to exploit any gaps in the Atalanta defense will be vital for their success in this away fixture.

Team Form and Analysis

Atalanta

Atalanta's defense has been a mixed bag, occasionally letting in soft goals, but their ferocious attack often compensates for any lapses. Key players like Duván Zapata and Luis Muriel have been crucial in securing vital wins, while the return of defender Rafael Tolói could bolster their backline as they aim to contain Dortmund's potent attack. Solid performances in the group stage have placed Atalanta in a favorable position, but they will need to tighten their parameters against the Bundesliga side.

Borussia Dortmund

Dortmund's offense has been nothing short of explosive, but their defense has been questioned, having conceded more than expected this season. The potential return of their star striker Erling Haaland adds a further layer of complexity as he has shown the capability to turn the game on its head. Manager Marco Rose might employ a high-pressing strategy to catch Atalanta off-guard, utilizing the speed of his wingers to break through their midfield. Injuries in the backline may pose a risk, compelling them to stay organized and focused to avoid any lapses that could lead to counter-attacks.
